userProfile.title: UserProfile
userProfile.description: User profile containing authentication details, game stats, and high scores

email.description: The email address of the user.

photoURL.description: Avatar photo URL of the user.

completedLevels.description: Array of level IDs completed by the user with score >= 50.

totalScore.description: Sum of all highest scores across all levels.

highScores.description: Object mapping level IDs to historical high scores.

timeTrialBestTimes.description: Object mapping level IDs to best remaining times in time trial mode.

timeTrialSuccesses.description: Array of level IDs where the user won in time trial mode.

completedDailyChallenges.description: Array of date strings representing daily challenges successfully completed (score >= 50).

dailyHighScores.description: Mapping from calendar date strings to the highest score achieved on that daily challenge.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user first logged in.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the user stats were last synced.

userSolution.title: UserSolution
userSolution.description: Historical record of scores and sub-elements achieved by the user for custom prompts

levelId.description: Level ID relating to the solved prompt.

prompt.description: The custom instruction text that was submitted.

submittedAt.description: The timestamp of this history record.

dailyChallenge.title: DailyChallenge
dailyChallenge.description: Dynamic daily prompt puzzle rotated in real-time

id.description: Static ID of the daily challenge.

targetKeywords.description: Keywords that must be matched in the evaluated prompt.

hints.description: Hint text describing how to engineering a solution.

proceduralTheme.description: Aesthetic style code for the prompt canvas renderer.

dateStr.description: The calendar day key when this challenge is served (e.g. '2026-06-18').

/users/{userId}.description: Document holding user gameplay and profile stats synchronized with the cloud.

/users/{userId}/solutions/{solutionId}.description: Sub-collection preserving details of individual level attempts or successful solutions.

/dailyChallenges/{challengeId}.description: Universal collection hosting the rotated daily challenge info.
